moments.author: Unknown (via multiple reports)
moments.quote: Tennessee death‑row inmate Christa Pike is still alive after two lethal injection doses—she was snoring, had a heartbeat, and execution halted.
moments.why: A shockingly botched execution attempt and the first of its kind is dominating conversation—not just morally but technically.

moments.author: Unknown (via ABC News)
moments.quote: Pike survived two injections, was still breathing and hospitalized; Tennessee has suspended executions pending investigation.
moments.why: Massive legal, ethical and procedural fallout in capital punishment unfolding in real time.

moments.author: Unknown (via CBS News)
moments.quote: Pike’s survival was “unparalleled”; witnesses reported she talked, snored and had a heartbeat hours after the injection.
moments.why: Adds human detail and expert context to the surreal unfolding event.

moments.author: Desman Stephens II
moments.quote: I want to sincerely apologize for my actions… my reaction in the moments afterward was completely inappropriate and inexcusable.
moments.why: The apology stems from a highly controversial hit on Oregon QB Dante Moore that is still sparking outrage among fans.
